_meta.notes: One booted CPU tagged 'lander', with the screen kOS itself draws on boot. The chunk is real VT (a clear-screen and a home, then the banner and prompt), so what renders is xterm's own interpretation of the bytes rather than a string in a box.

_scene.caption: Attached to the 'lander' CPU with line-mode composition on: what the operator types is held in the bar under the screen until Enter sends it as one command
